FN-HB5738-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 136
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Prince Chestnut
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/05/2023
House Bill 136 as introduced would (1) require the Alabama Supreme Court to establish per
diem and mileage rates for jurors by order or rule of the court, and (2) repeal the current $10 per
diem and $0.05 mileage rate.
According to the Administrative Office of the Courts (AOC), the new rates proposed by the
Supreme Court would be $0.625 per mile and $25 per day. Using Fiscal Year 2022 jury data,
these rates would increase jury expenses by an estimated $3,795,000 annually.
The Fiscal Year 2024 State General Fund appropriation bill (House Bill 124), as introduced and
as substituted by the House Ways and Means General Fund committee, includes an
appropriation of $3,795,000 to the Unified Judicial System for a juror pay increase.
